selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: In the palace speech, what does the king want people to do first about him?
questions.answer: Know him and learn about him.

questions.question: How should people answer the love shown in the many blessings?
questions.answer: By loving the owner and obeying him.

questions.question: What do the special marks on each artwork show?
questions.answer: That each thing belongs to him and is made by him.

questions.question: What made the first group ready to understand the palace rightly?
questions.answer: They had good sense and upright hearts.

questions.question: What made the first group want to learn more?
questions.answer: They were curious about the secret and meaning of the palace.

questions.question: What did the teacher repeat for them?
questions.answer: The message about the owner and what he wanted.

questions.question: What did the first group do after learning the king’s wishes?
questions.answer: They acted the way the king wanted.

questions.question: What did the second group care about most?
questions.answer: Eating the delicious food.

questions.question: What did the second group do with drinks that were not for them to use that way?
questions.answer: They drank them and became drunk.

questions.question: What was the end for the second group?
questions.answer: They were taken away by soldiers and put in prison.

questions.question: Why did the teacher say the king built and showed this palace to the people?
questions.answer: To let them know him.

questions.question: What do the blessings in the palace show about the king’s feelings toward the people?
questions.answer: He cares for them and loves them.

questions.question: What do the signs placed on all the artworks teach about the maker?
questions.answer: That he alone made them and they belong to him.

questions.question: What happened after the teacher finished speaking to the people?
questions.answer: They became two groups.

questions.question: Did the first group think the palace was just for fun?
questions.answer: No. They knew it had a real purpose.

questions.question: What did the first group believe about the teacher before asking him?
questions.answer: That he was truthful and exact.

questions.question: What connection is shown between listening and doing?
questions.answer: After they listened and accepted, they obeyed properly.

questions.question: What weakened the second group’s ability to respond well?
questions.answer: Their corrupted minds and dead hearts.

questions.question: How did the second group act toward the teacher and his helpers?
questions.answer: They shut out the guidance and warnings.

questions.question: Why was their behavior especially wrong in the palace?
questions.answer: It went against the owner’s rules.

questions.question: According to the speech, what does the king want from the people when he shows them the palace?
questions.answer: He wants them to recognize him.

questions.question: What should people do because the owner shows love through many blessings?
questions.answer: Love him and obey him.

questions.question: Why are special signs placed on every crafted thing?
questions.answer: To show the king made them himself and that they are his.

questions.question: Into how many groups did the visitors divide?
questions.answer: Two.

title: Parable Invitation by the Explaining Master and Conduct of the Two Groups
